nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
Fetch Leads
nodes.notes:
Fetches leads for comparison study.

Uses limit from webhook payload or defaults to 50.

nodes.name: Split Into Items
nodes.notes: Splits leads array for individual processing.

nodes.name: Compare All Methods
nodes.notes:
Calls /compare endpoint for each lead.

This runs all 3 scoring methods:
- Rule-based
- Logistic Regression
- Random Forest

Batched: 5 per 2 seconds to avoid overload.

nodes.name: Analyze Results
nodes.notes:
Analyzes comparison results:
- Agreement rate (how often all 3 methods agree)
- Average delta (score difference)
- Average latency per method
- Category distribution
